variants.name: 700 g
variants.about_this_item:
• Mixture with vegetables for (dwarf) rabbits up to 8 months
  • Grain-free formula with high fibre content for healthy teeth
  • Naturally varied mixture full of herbs and grasses like timothy hay, with tasty vegetables such as peas and carrots
  • Vitamins and minerals support growth
  • Tasty mixture with extruded morsels for optimal intake and digestion, no pressed pellets. No artificial colours, flavours or preservatives
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: derivatives of vegetable origin (timothy, grasses and herbs 18.5%), vegetables (peas 15%, tic beans 6%, carrots 4%, beetroot 4%), fruit, vegetable protein extracts, seeds, minerals, FOS, MOS, algae, yucca.

Analytical constituents: crude protein 15.5%, crude fat 2.7%, crude fibre 14%, crude ash 7%, calcium 0.7%, phosphorus 0.56%.

Nutritional additives per kg: vitamin A 9750 IU, vitamin D3 1170 IU, vitamin E 80 mg, vitamin C 80 mg, iron 100 mg, iodine 2 mg, copper 10 mg, manganese 73 mg, zinc 70 mg, selenium 0.2 mg.
variants.feeding_instructions: An average daily portion of 50–80 g is recommended, depending on your rabbit's size and breed. For a complete feeding plan, combine with Nature Timothy Hay and make sure hay is always available. Refresh drinking water daily. For extra variety, combine with Nature Snacks. Tip for picky eaters: only refill the bowl when it is empty, so every meal stays balanced. Not for food-producing animals.
